name: Tebex
description: Sell packages from your Tebex store in game and deliver them to your players

static_functions.name: OpenCheckoutOverlay
static_functions.description: Opens the Tebex checkout of a package for a player, over the in-game menu
static_functions.description_details: The server creates a basket with the package for the player's Steam ID, so the purchase is linked to that player without any login. Once Tebex answers, the player's in-game menu opens with the checkout popup, the same one the in-game store shows, and the player decides whether to pay

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player who will buy the package

parameters.name: package_id
parameters.description: The ID of the package in your Tebex store

static_functions.name: GetCategoriesAsync
static_functions.description: Requests the categories of your Tebex store, with their packages
static_functions.description_details: The list comes from the Tebex Headless API, as the array of categories Tebex returns, each with its packages, using the field names from the Tebex Headless API documentation. The package id is the one Tebex.OpenCheckoutOverlay takes

function_parameters.name: success
function_parameters.description: False if the store is not set up or Tebex could not be reached

function_parameters.name: categories
function_parameters.description: The categories with their packages, nil on failure

static_functions.name: GetPublicToken
static_functions.description: Gets the public token of your Tebex store
static_functions.description_details: Use it to call the Tebex Headless API yourself, for example from a HTTP request. It is the same token your store page uses, so it is safe to share with players

return.description: The public token, or an empty string

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback to run on the event occurring

static_functions.name: Unsubscribe
static_functions.description: Unsubscribes from all subscribed Events in this Class and in this Package, optionally passing the function to unsubscribe only that callback

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Optional callback to specifically unsubscribe to

events.name: OnlineCommand
events.description: Called when an online command of a purchase is about to run for a connected player
events.description_details:
Online commands only run while their player is on the server. The {id}, {steamid}, {username} and {name} placeholders are already replaced in command.

Return false to handle the purchase in your script instead of running command in the server console. A handled command is removed from the Tebex queue. If you don't return false and no Package handles command in the console, it stays in the queue and this event is called again on the next fetch

return.description: Return false to prevent the command from running in the server console

arguments.name: command_id
arguments.description: The ID of this command in the Tebex queue

arguments.name: package_id
arguments.description: The ID of the package bought

arguments.name: command
arguments.description: The command configured in the Tebex package, with its placeholders replaced

arguments.name: player
arguments.description: The player who receives the purchase

events.name: OfflineCommand
events.description: Called when an offline command of a purchase is about to run
events.description_details:
Offline commands run whether or not their player is on the server, so the player is given by their Steam ID and name. The {id}, {steamid}, {username} and {name} placeholders are already replaced in command.

Return false to handle the purchase in your script instead of running command in the server console. A handled command is removed from the Tebex queue. If you don't return false and no Package handles command in the console, it stays in the queue and this event is called again on the next fetch

return.description: Return false to prevent the command from running in the server console

arguments.name: command_id
arguments.description: The ID of this command in the Tebex queue

arguments.name: package_id
arguments.description: The ID of the package bought

arguments.name: command
arguments.description: The command configured in the Tebex package, with its placeholders replaced

arguments.name: tebex_player_id
arguments.description: The internal Tebex ID of the player

arguments.name: player_steam_id
arguments.description: The Steam ID of the player
